sections.title: Prerequisite Review: Conditional Probability
lecture_lines: Conditional probability updates beliefs with information.
P(A|B) narrows focus to subset B.
Think: If Red, is it a Heart?
animations: Draw two sets A and B in color #FFFFFF.
Highlight intersection A ∩ B in color #FFFF00.
Label A ∩ B as 'Joint Probability' in #FF00FF.
Shade B as 'Given B' in #00FFFF.
Display formula P(A|B) = P(A ∩ B) / P(B).

sections.title: The Concept of Independence
lecture_lines: Independence means B provides no info about A.
Flipping coins and dice are independent events.
animations: Show circles A and B as independent with #FFFFFF.
Display P(A ∩ B) = P(A)P(B) in #FFFFFF.
Highlight P(A|B) = P(A) with color #00FF00.

sections.title: Introducing Bayes' Theorem
lecture_lines: We use evidence to find our hypothesis.
Prior, Likelihood, Evidence, Posterior form the cycle.
A sniffer dog detects a hidden treat.
We update our belief after evidence appears.
animations: Show Bayes' Theorem formula in center in #FFFFFF.
Highlight P(B|A) in #FF0000 on formula left.
Highlight P(A|B) in #0000FF on formula right.
Display 'Prior, Likelihood, Posterior' tags in white.
Show sniffer dog icon.

sections.title: The Core Calculation: Bayes' Formula
lecture_lines: Total probability defines our denominator P(E).
A tree diagram visualizes these branching paths.
Medical tests must account for false positives.
animations: Display formula P(H|E) = P(E|H)P(H) / P(E) in #FFFFFF.
Show tree diagram with branches in #00FF80.
Highlight P(E) calculation as a sum in #FF8000.
Show test result branches in #FFFFFF.
Label posterior calculation steps in bold #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Synthesis & Summary
lecture_lines: Independence simplifies, while Bayes' updates probabilities.
Bayes' is the heart of modern machine learning.
Spam filters use Bayes' to classify emails.
animations: Flash all major Bayes formulas in sequence.
Fade to central summary box in #FFFFFF.
Highlight 'Updating beliefs' text in #FFFF00.
